comparison.objective: Align two boards edge-to-edge and clamp them with a trigger bar clamp; candidate fixtures a machined part using temporary lifting hardware.
comparison.physical_skill: Clamp placement, trigger pumping, board alignment, and force buildup versus pin insertion and locking, shackle lifting, suspended seating, unloading, and extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Boards closed, aligned, level, and held at at least 20 N after release versus pin retention and lift stages followed by three-pad seating, pin removal, and stable hand clearance.
comparison.reason: Both involve a spring-operated mechanism and force retention, but clamping a joint does not test temporary lifting, suspended alignment, or hardware recovery; numeric rubrics are available.
